units.locator: Chapter 1. GENERAL PROVISIONS
units.text: Chapter 1. GENERAL PROVISIONS
units.label: Chapter 1. GENERAL PROVISIONS

units.locator: Article 1. Subject Matter Governed by This Federal Law
units.text: Article 1. Subject Matter Governed by This Federal Law
units.label: Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Subject Matter Governed by This Federal Law
units.text: 1. This Federal Law governs relationships connected with entry into municipal service by citizens of the Russian Federation and citizens of foreign states that are parties to international treaties of the Russian Federation under which foreign citizens are entitled to serve in municipal service (hereinafter referred to as citizens), with the performance and termination of municipal service, and with determining the legal position (status) of municipal servants.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Subject Matter Governed by This Federal Law
units.text: 2. This Federal Law does not determine the status of deputies, members of elected local self-government bodies or elected local self-government officials, since those persons (hereinafter referred to as persons holding municipal offices) are not municipal servants.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 2. Municipal Service
units.text: Article 2. Municipal Service
units.label: Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. Municipal Service
units.text: 1. Municipal service means the professional activity of citizens carried out on a permanent basis in municipal service positions filled through the conclusion of an employment agreement (contract).
units.label: Part 1 Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. Municipal Service
units.text: 2. The employer of a municipal servant is the municipality, on whose behalf the powers of the employer are exercised by the employer’s representative (employer).
units.label: Part 2 Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. Municipal Service
units.text: 3. The employer’s representative (employer) may be the head of the municipality, the head of a local self-government body, or another person authorized to perform the duties of the employer’s representative (employer).
units.label: Part 3 Art. 2

units.locator: Article 3. Legal Foundations of Municipal Service in the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 3. Legal Foundations of Municipal Service in the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Legal Foundations of Municipal Service in the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. The legal foundations of municipal service in the Russian Federation consist of the Constitution of the Russian Federation, this Federal Law and other federal laws, other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, constitutions (charters), laws and other normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation (hereinafter referred to as municipal service legislation), charters of municipalities, decisions adopted at citizens’ assemblies, and other municipal legal acts.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Legal Foundations of Municipal Service in the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. Labor legislation applies to municipal servants subject to the special provisions of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 4. Basic Principles of Municipal Service
units.text: Article 4. Basic Principles of Municipal Service
units.label: Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Basic Principles of Municipal Service
units.text: The basic principles of municipal service are:
units.label: Art. 4 · “The basic principles of municipal service are:”

units.locator: Article 4. Basic Principles of Municipal Service
units.text: 1) the priority of human and civil rights and freedoms;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Basic Principles of Municipal Service
units.text: 2) equal access to municipal service for citizens who have command of the state language of the Russian Federation, and equal conditions of service regardless of sex, race, ethnicity, origin, property or official status, place of residence, attitude to religion, beliefs, membership in public associations, or other circumstances unrelated to a municipal servant’s professional and work-related qualities;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Basic Principles of Municipal Service
units.text: 3) the professionalism and competence of municipal servants;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Basic Principles of Municipal Service
units.text: 4) the stability of municipal service;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Basic Principles of Municipal Service
units.text: 5) the accessibility of information on municipal servants’ activities;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Basic Principles of Municipal Service
units.text: 6) interaction with public associations and citizens;
units.label: Point 6 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Basic Principles of Municipal Service
units.text: 7) uniform basic requirements for municipal service, and consideration of historical and other local traditions in the performance of municipal service;
units.label: Point 7 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Basic Principles of Municipal Service
units.text: 8) legal and social protection of municipal servants;
units.label: Point 8 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Basic Principles of Municipal Service
units.text: 9) municipal servants’ liability for failure to perform, or improper performance of, their official duties;
units.label: Point 9 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Basic Principles of Municipal Service
units.text: 10) the nonpartisan nature of municipal service.
units.label: Point 10 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 5. Interrelationship between Municipal Service and State Civil Service of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 5. Interrelationship between Municipal Service and State Civil Service of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Interrelationship between Municipal Service and State Civil Service of the Russian Federation
units.text: The interrelationship between municipal service and state civil service of the Russian Federation (hereinafter referred to as state civil service) is ensured through:
units.label: Art. 5 · “The interrelationship between municipal service and state civil…”

units.locator: Article 5. Interrelationship between Municipal Service and State Civil Service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1) uniform basic qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions and state civil service positions;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Interrelationship between Municipal Service and State Civil Service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2) uniform restrictions and obligations in the performance of municipal service and state civil service;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Interrelationship between Municipal Service and State Civil Service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 3) uniform requirements for the training of personnel for municipal and civil service and for additional professional education;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Interrelationship between Municipal Service and State Civil Service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 4) counting length of municipal service when calculating length of state civil service, and counting length of state civil service when calculating length of municipal service;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Interrelationship between Municipal Service and State Civil Service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 5) comparability of the basic remuneration conditions and social guarantees for municipal servants and state civil servants;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Interrelationship between Municipal Service and State Civil Service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 6) comparability of the basic conditions of state pension provision for citizens who have served in municipal service and citizens who have served in state civil service, and for their family members in the event of the loss of a breadwinner.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 5

units.locator: Chapter 2. MUNICIPAL SERVICE POSITIONS
units.text: Chapter 2. MUNICIPAL SERVICE POSITIONS
units.label: Chapter 2. MUNICIPAL SERVICE POSITIONS

units.locator: Article 6. Municipal Service Positions
units.text: Article 6. Municipal Service Positions
units.label: Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Municipal Service Positions
units.text: 1. A municipal service position is a position in a local self-government body established in accordance with the municipality’s charter, with a defined set of duties to support the exercise of the powers of the local self-government body or a person holding a municipal office.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Municipal Service Positions
units.text: 2. Municipal service positions are established by municipal legal acts in accordance with the register of municipal service positions in the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, approved by a law of that constituent entity.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Municipal Service Positions
units.text: 3. When drawing up and approving the staffing schedule of a local self-government body, the municipal service position titles specified in the register of municipal service positions in the constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be used.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 7. Register of Municipal Service Positions in a Constituent Entity of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 7. Register of Municipal Service Positions in a Constituent Entity of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Register of Municipal Service Positions in a Constituent Entity of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. The register of municipal service positions in a constituent entity of the Russian Federation is a list of municipal service position titles classified by local self-government body, position group and functional characteristics, determined with due regard to historical and other local traditions.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Register of Municipal Service Positions in a Constituent Entity of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. The register of municipal service positions in a constituent entity of the Russian Federation may include municipal service positions established to provide direct support for the exercise of the powers of a person holding a municipal office. Municipal servants fill such positions through an employment contract concluded for the term of office of that person.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 8. Classification of Municipal Service Positions
units.text: Article 8. Classification of Municipal Service Positions
units.label: Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Classification of Municipal Service Positions
units.text: 1. Municipal service positions are divided into the following groups:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Classification of Municipal Service Positions
units.text: 1) highest municipal service positions;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Classification of Municipal Service Positions
units.text: 2) principal municipal service positions;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Classification of Municipal Service Positions
units.text: 3) leading municipal service positions;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Classification of Municipal Service Positions
units.text: 4) senior municipal service positions;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Classification of Municipal Service Positions
units.text: 5) junior municipal service positions.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Classification of Municipal Service Positions
units.text: 2. The correspondence between municipal service positions and state civil service positions of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, taking account of the qualification requirements for the respective municipal service and state civil service positions, is established by a law of that constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 9. Basic Qualification Requirements for Filling Municipal Service Positions
units.text: Article 9. Basic Qualification Requirements for Filling Municipal Service Positions
units.label: Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Basic Qualification Requirements for Filling Municipal Service Positions
units.text: 1. Filling a municipal service position requires compliance with qualification requirements concerning the level of professional education, length of municipal service or work experience in a specialty or field of training, and the knowledge and skills necessary to perform official duties, and, where the employer’s representative (employer) has adopted a corresponding decision, concerning the specialty or field of training.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Basic Qualification Requirements for Filling Municipal Service Positions
units.text: 2. Qualification requirements concerning the level of professional education and length of municipal service or work experience in a specialty or field of training necessary to fill municipal service positions are established by municipal legal acts on the basis of standard qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions, which are determined by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in accordance with the classification of municipal service positions. Qualification requirements concerning the knowledge and skills necessary to perform official duties are established in the municipal servant’s job description depending on the area and type of the servant’s professional official activity. The municipal servant’s job description may also provide for qualification requirements concerning the specialty or field of training.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Basic Qualification Requirements for Filling Municipal Service Positions
units.text: 3. Where a person is appointed as head of the local administration under a contract, additional requirements for candidates for that position may be established by the charter of the settlement or intra-city district, and, for the position of head of the local administration of a municipal district (municipal okrug, urban okrug, or urban okrug with intra-city divisions) or an intra-city municipality of a city of federal significance, by the charter of that municipal district (municipal okrug, urban okrug, or urban okrug with intra-city divisions) or intra-city municipality of a city of federal significance and by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9.1. Class Ranks of Municipal Servants
units.text: Article 9.1. Class Ranks of Municipal Servants
units.label: Art. 9.1

units.locator: Article 9.1. Class Ranks of Municipal Servants
units.text: 1. A law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation may provide for class ranks of municipal servants and establish the procedure for their assignment, as well as the procedure for retaining them when municipal servants are transferred to other municipal service positions or leave municipal service.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 9.1

units.locator: Article 9.1. Class Ranks of Municipal Servants
units.text: 2. Class ranks indicate that municipal servants’ level of professional training meets the qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 9.1
